Paper: Revisiting Audio-language Pretraining for Learning General-purpose Audio Representation

Dataset_public: CaptionStew aggregates open audio-text corpora and the authors release preparation recipes; this is not necessarily one redistributable tarball because component dataset licenses/access differ.
Dataset: CaptionStew: 10.7M captions over 9.3M audio samples, ~37,290 hours spanning speech, music and environmental sound.
